counters.why: Players report Silk can finish Count Nefaria quickly before his defensive charge and Power loops become the main problem.
counters.strategy: Bait and partially dex the end of his Special Attack when needed for a punish window, then use Silk's normal Heavy Attack and Special Attack 2 burst only after the opening is secure.
counters.risks: Nefaria's resistance can blunt burst damage, and some Battlegrounds nodes interact strongly with his Signature Ability and Power gain.
conditions: Do not assume one Special Attack 2 always finishes a high-rank Nefaria.
Learn the Special Attack punish timing before relying on speed.
counters.scoreReason: Direct Battlegrounds player reports support Silk; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Shang-Chi is directly reported as a fast Count Nefaria option, with Cleanse and Slow giving useful control while he builds his burst.
counters.strategy: Cycle Wushu Strikes without rushing into Nefaria's Evade timing, use Cleanse when needed, and save the Special Attack 2 burst for a clean punish window.
counters.risks: Nefaria can become highly resistant once his charges are established. A slow setup can turn a favorable matchup into a time loss.
conditions: Respect Nefaria's Evade timing even when Slow is available.
Seasonal Power nodes can change how aggressively you can cycle Wushu Strikes.
counters.scoreReason: Direct Battlegrounds player reports support Shang-Chi; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Hulkling is repeatedly listed by players as an Arcade counter, with Poison immunity and access to Unblockable pressure reducing two common sources of friction.
counters.strategy: Build Pierce and your Unblockable window before committing the main burst, and continue respecting Arcade's current trap and token state instead of attacking on autopilot.
counters.risks: Poison immunity and Unblockable do not switch off Arcade's entire kit. Node-added control effects can still punish an aggressive rotation.
conditions: Reach a controlled Unblockable window before forcing offense into Auto-Block behavior.
Keep reading Arcade's active trap and token state.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter lists repeatedly include Hulkling; the matchup is not independently timed in the current season.

counters.why: Gladiator is a community-listed Arcade option whose Confidence ramp rewards clean punish windows and fast pressure.
counters.strategy: Build Confidence through safe openings, use Vigilance when Arcade's defensive state makes it relevant, and reserve your burst for a window that will not be interrupted by the active trap.
counters.risks: This is a player-reported option rather than a tested hard counter. Arcade's active utility can still break the normal rotation.
conditions: Check Arcade's current trap before starting the burst.
Do not assume Confidence alone prevents Auto-Block or other defensive effects.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter lists support Gladiator; the matchup is not independently timed in the current season.

counters.why: Players list Deathless Thanos as an Arcade answer; Armor Shattered and sustained Corrosion give him ways to make progress without relying on one clean critical burst.
counters.strategy: Use Heavy Attack to establish Armor Shattered, then cycle Special Attacks for Fury and Corrosion while continuing to respect Arcade's active defensive state.
counters.risks: Armor Shattered does not mean every Arcade mechanic is disabled. Trap timing and node effects still matter.
conditions: Do not treat Armor Shattered as a universal Auto-Block bypass.
Check whether the current node punishes Heavy Attacks or repeated Debuffs.
